affected_subject.reason: Identifies multiSplit() in VotingEscrow.sol and permanentLockBalance as affected component/state.

trigger_or_action.reason: Concrete trigger: splitting a permanent veNFT via multiSplit into >=2 children with non-divisible allocations.

direct_effect.reason: Floor division loses locked value and permanentLockBalance is not reconciled, exceeding true permanent total.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Explicit invariants: sum of child amounts must equal parent amount, and permanentLockBalance must equal sum of permanent locks.

summary: All four dimensions are supported: multiSplit floor-division split of permanent veNFTs causes locked-value loss and permanentLockBalance drift, violating stated conservation and accounting invariants.
